name: Illegal Mining and Precious Metals Laundering
description: Extraction of gold, diamonds, coltan and other minerals without licence or in breach of law, and the laundering of resulting metals through scrap dealers, refiners, jewellers and traders. Linkages to armed groups, environmental damage and forced labour raise the stakes.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
OECD, OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals from Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas, Third Edition (2016)
FATF and APG, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risks and Vulnerabilities Associated with Gold (2015)
UN Security Council expert panel reports on illicit mineral trade

exposure.rationale: Gold and gem dealers, refiners and scrap buyers pay cash to informal miners, then deposit and export; metals are real assets.

indicators.name: Gold of unclear origin sold to refiners or exporters
indicators.canon: Unclear provenance of gold, metals or stones
indicators.desc: Gold, metals or stones lack licence, assay or chain-of-custody evidence of origin, or are claimed as recycled scrap.
indicators.ctx: Customer sells gold or concentrate with no mine licence, assay or chain-of-custody documents.
indicators.fp: Artisanal miners often lack formal paperwork.

indicators.name: Exports exceeding official production of origin country
indicators.canon: Volumes exceed documented production or capacity
indicators.desc: Exports or output reported exceed documented production, concession or capacity limits.
indicators.ctx: Quantities exported by a country or trader exceed credible domestic production.
indicators.fp: Trade statistics can have timing differences.

indicators.name: Large cash purchases from informal miners and traders
indicators.canon: Cash payments to informal suppliers or ground-level operators
indicators.desc: Large or repeated cash payments to informal traders, producers or workers in extraction or supply chains.
indicators.ctx: Dealer pays cash at remote sites and deposits to bank accounts mixed with legitimate sales.
indicators.fp: Artisanal mining economies are cash based.

indicators.name: Dealer with no licence or with licences used by third parties
indicators.canon: Missing, misused or unverifiable licence or registration
indicators.desc: Customer offering a regulated or permitted activity cannot evidence the required licence or registration, or operates under a licence held by another party.
indicators.ctx: Licence-holder 'rents' licence to others or licences conflict with location.

indicators.name: Jewellery, scrap gold or recycled metal used to mask origin
indicators.canon: Jewellery, scrap gold or recycled metal used to mask origin
indicators.desc: Surge in 'scrap' or 'recycled' gold from small sellers with no records.
indicators.ctx: Surge in 'scrap' or 'recycled' gold from small sellers with no records.

indicators.name: Links to armed groups or sanctioned parties in conflict areas
indicators.canon: Armed-group territory or sanctioned parties in conflict areas
indicators.desc: Trade, production or payments involve territories controlled by armed groups or parties linked to them.
indicators.ctx: Mining or trade in territories controlled by armed groups with payments to checkpoints.

indicators.name: Mercury, cyanide and equipment purchases without mining licence
indicators.canon: Mercury, cyanide and equipment purchases without mining licence
indicators.desc: Purchase of dredges, mercury or bulk chemicals by unlicensed persons.
indicators.ctx: Purchase of dredges, mercury or bulk chemicals by unlicensed persons.

indicators.name: Diamond or gem trade with undervalued or round-trip transactions
indicators.canon: Diamond or gem trade with undervalued or round-trip transactions
indicators.desc: Stones traded at prices off market, flowing through several traders and returning to origin.
indicators.ctx: Stones traded at prices off market, flowing through several traders and returning to origin.
